# ZS Table Column Width Pattern
Writing a fixed width on zs-table-column bypasses the component's automatic column width calculation.
## Behavior
- Without explicit width, zs-table-column uses flexible layout, auto-computing min-width from header and content and distributing remaining width equally.
- Manual fixed width overrides the adaptive sizing.
## Usage
- Reference depositNotice/company/components/AddDialog.vue: keep only label and prop to fill dialog and adapt.
- Apply this pattern to avoid unexpected column sizing in maintenance module dialogs.

# Login Project Dialog Switch Logic
Enterprise login project popup is controlled by flag ENABLE_B_TERMINAL_PROJECT_DIALOG_ON_LOGIN with specific conditions.
## Logic
- Popup shows only when multiple communities exist and no valid cache is present.
- Empty list or only one community does not trigger the popup.
- Branches develop/v2.6.2 (commit b9412a507) and develop/v2.6.2-yulin (merge 69ea69f0a, conflict file serviceItem/detail.vue used fixed version) established this logic.

# Project Dialog Switch Disabled

- In zhi2-web-admin/src/utils/projectContext.js, ENABLE_B_TERMINAL_PROJECT_DIALOG_ON_LOGIN was set to false (commit bf2512af8).
- This actively turned off the enterprise login project selection popup.
## Fix
- Restore popup by changing the constant to true.
